jobs.title: Clinical Trial Manager
jobs.description: Precision for Medicine is looking for an experienced Clinical Trial Manager to join our growing team. Candidates can work remotely in Hungary, Poland, Romania, Serbia or Slovakia. Precision for Medicine is a precision medicine CRO. Precision’s uniquely integrated offering enables the science of precision medicine by combining novel clinical trial designs, industry-leading operational and medical experts, advanced biomarker and data analytics solutions, and an unequivocal real passion for rare diseases and oncology, in addition to working across other therapeutic areas. You will be the hub of central intelligence for the studies you will be managing and will lead CRAs and oversee all clinical aspects of your study across multiple countries, ensuring timeline adherence and scope, whilst ensuring quality delivery. We encourage high-energy, dedicated professionals who enjoy a challenge, thrive in the details and flourish in dynamic environments to explore this opportunity. We are addressing the challenges facing the research and development of novel compounds in Oncology and are dedicated to positively impacting the health and lives of patients around the world. If you take a consultative approach to trial management, proving to be a valuable partner in the trial operational delivery process, don't miss exploring working with us. About You: You love having responsibility and a say in how clinical trials are run You plan ahead, but have alternative options and a flexible approach You are client focused You are well organised and able to manage timelines and shifting priorities, without sacrificing quality. jobs.title: Behavioral Health Coach
jobs.description: Brightline is redefining what pediatric behavioral health care looks like for families across the country, and we're looking for the warm, skilled Behavioral Health Coach who will bring that vision to life from anywhere in the U.S. This is a fully remote coaching role for someone who loves helping kids, teens, and caregivers build skills that make everyday life at home easier. You’ll deliver 1:1 coaching by video and chat, help families find the right support within Brightline, and partner closely with our therapists and psychiatric providers. Coaches teach skills and support families alongside our clinical team, and we don’t provide supervision toward clinical licensure. Location & schedule: Open to candidates in any U.S. state. Coaches work one of two fixed shifts: 11:00 a.m.–7:00 p.m. or 12:00 p.m.–8:00 p.m. Pacific Time. Why This Role One in five kids has a behavioral health condition, yet up to 80% get little or no help. Our coaches are often a family’s first real connection to Brightline, and the steady support that helps new skills stick at home. You’ll work from thoughtfully designed programs and digital tools built to take busywork off your plate, so your time goes where it matters most: with families. You’ll also help shape the workshops, classes, and content that reach families beyond 1:1 care. jobs.description: Data Science Lead | Semiconductor Metrology Abingdon, UK Reward and Benefits £70,000 - £85,000 (depending on experience) Annual bonus, 3x salary death in service benefit and private health care BUPA, EMI Share scheme. If you are a Data Science Lead who enjoys turning measurement data into proof of what is possible, why not join us in Abingdon, Oxfordshire, and build and lead the Data Science team behind advanced semiconductor metrology systems. We are looking for an ambitious and adaptable Data Science Lead to set up a new Data Science team in our Technology department, reporting to the Technology Director. You will lead a small team, initially a Data Scientist and a Modelling Scientist, and stay hands-on as a working lead data scientist. You will explore and prove new analysis methods, from synthetic data and information-limit studies to modelling, machine learning and AI, to improve the performance of our Metron3D systems and draw more insight from our data. You will work hand in hand with the Data Analysis team in Engineering: you prove what is possible, they make it robust and shippable. You will also collaborate with R&D, System Design Engineering and Applications Development. We are an AI-first team, and you will set the standard for using AI tools well and safely. jobs.description: Resolve to Save Lives (RTSL) is a global health organization that partners locally and globally to create and scale solutions to the world’s deadliest health threats. Millions of people die from preventable health threats. We collaborate to close the gap between proven, life-saving solutions and the people who need them. Since 2017, we’ve worked with governments and other partners in more than 60 countries to save millions of lives. We work toward a future where people live longer, healthier lives, communities flourish, and economies thrive. This is an ambitious vision, and it inspires us and our partners to make progress every day.   Resolve to Save Lives (RTSL) works with governments and partners to strengthen and transform primary health care (PHC) to improve health and save lives. Our approach focuses on making PHC more prioritised, proactive and accountable for outcomes, and strengthening how care is organised, delivered, financed and measured. Drawing on expertise across RTSL s portfolio, we bring together solutions in health system resilience and epidemic readiness, digital health and data-driven decision-making, performance measurement and improvement, and sustainable health financing. We apply these capabilities to address priority health challenges, including cardiovascular health, maternal survival and sexual and reproductive health, while strengthening health systems to deliver more equitable, effective and resilient care.   Position Purpose The Senior Technical Advisor, Clinical Services & Health Systems Transformation will provide senior-level technical expertise to strengthen how health services are organised, managed and delivered, with an initial focus on improving maternal survival and reproductive health outcomes. Drawing on deep clinical experience and specialized expertise in health systems strengthening, systems thinking, and change management, the role leads complex technical initiatives and supports governments and country teams

jobs.description: About myTomorrows myTomorrows is a global health tech company dedicated to breaking down barriers for patients seeking treatment options. We strive to enable earlier and better treatment access by bridging the gap between those searching for possible options, and the companies who develop them. We work closely with patients, healthcare professionals, trial sites, patient advocacy groups, and BioPharma – connecting key stakeholders in the drug development ecosystem. We’ve developed a cutting-edge AI-powered technology platform that simplifies and streamlines access to drugs in development. To support our users and clients, we have a range of industry-expert specialized teams ready to help. Our services include clinical trial patient recruitment, Expanded Access Program management and Real-World Data collection. With a global footprint spanning 134 countries, to date we’ve supported over 17,000 patients, 3,000 physicians and 350 sites, earning the trust of 60+ BioPharma companies. In October 2025, we closed a €25M investment with Avego Healthcare Capital to fuel our global ambitions and scale the business. Join us in shaping the future of treatment access - making tomorrow’s therapies accessible for people who need them today.
